title: Run calls v1
description: Body of GET /runs/{run_id}/calls on the agent runtime: the run's LLM calls that got a reply so far (D12, P2.2a, P2.6b), as the agent saved them. Field names follow trace.v1.

run_id.description: Same value as the x-run-id header of the run's calls.

calls.description: In step order. Holds every call so far, so a later answer replaces an earlier one. A call that got no reply has no entry.

items.description: One call. A measurement the reply did not have is left out, so it never reads as 0.

step.description: Same value as the x-step header of the call, and as step in its run-events.v1 step event.

ts_start.description: When the call was sent, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

gap_before_ms.description: From the end of the previous reply to this call's start; 0 on step 1.

prompt_tokens.description: At least 1: a chat prompt always holds the system prompt, so a cached share of it is defined.

cached_tokens.description: How many prompt tokens came from the prefix cache; 0 on a miss.

pod.description: The name of the pod that served the call.
